hypothesis: a model trained on crypto alone reads crypto better than a model trained on everything and evaluated on crypto
theOneThingChanged: the training population; features, target, horizon, split, embargo, seed, hyperparameters and imputation are brain-v2-context's

baselines.priceOnlyCrypto: fitted in this run on the same rows, 15 features

preDeclaredCriteria.accuracyAboveHoldoutMajority: strictly above 0.4723, the holdout's largest class (DOWN)
preDeclaredCriteria.beatsTheMultiMarketModelOnCrypto: strictly above 0.5143, brain-v2-context on these rows
preDeclaredCriteria.notDegenerate: no predicted class exceeds 0.7 of the holdout while being under half of it
preDeclaredCriteria.bothDirectionsPredicted: recall at least 0.25 for DOWN and at least 0.25 for UP, so the model is reading direction and not leaning on one side
preDeclaredCriteria.setBefore: any number from this run was seen; see the commit that introduced this file

promotionRule: NOT promoted on this evaluation under any outcome. The window 2026-01-01..2026-09-25 has been scored by the baseline experiment, the balanced experiment and brain-v2-context, so it is diagnostic and never independent. A pass licenses freezing the candidate and starting its own prospective prediction stream; promotion is decided later on matured forward outcomes against these same criteria.

holdout.exposure: scored by the baseline experiment, the balanced experiment and brain-v2-context; diagnostic, never independent

limitations: direction only; no execution-cost, spread or borrow data exists, so nothing here is a profitability claim and no drawdown or turnover figure is given.
the effective sample is rows / 20; the row count is not the sample size.
crypto trades every day, so a 20-session window is 20 calendar days here and about 28 for equities; the horizons are not the same length in wall-clock time.
the holdout is not pristine; see evaluation.holdout.exposure.
